topic: Missing analytics data for specific date
summary_markdown: The discussion concerns missing analytics data observed on October 7th (23:00–24:00 UTC). Initially, the `seen_ch` metric was absent during the archive/recalculation process. This absence caused related data to fail appearing on the dashboard. It was suggested that a potential failure or drop in the datagrinder system might explain this discrepancy.
action_items: Investigate if the datagrinder system experienced an outage during the specified time frame.
